templates.name: elysia backend template
templates.description: Production ready Elysia + Bun + TypeScript template. It implements repository pattern, distributed rate limiting with the redis + sliding window algorithm, the application is containerized with docker and docker-compose. Redis support, Server Factory, OpenApi Documentation.

templates.name: NestJS Backend Template
templates.description: Production-ready NestJS 11 boilerplate featuring Fastify, Drizzle ORM, Better-Auth, and BullMQ. Implements repository pattern, distributed background workers, and automated OpenAPI documentation with a custom Server Factory and Docker orchestration.
